name: TLP2761(TP,E
title: TLP2761: 15 MBd logic-output photocoupler, 2.7 V to 5.5 V, 125 °C, SO6L
summary: A single-channel high-speed photocoupler: a GaAlAs infrared LED optically coupled to a photo IC with an inverting totem-pole logic output and an internal Faraday shield. It runs from 2.7 V to 5.5 V over -40 °C to 125 °C, typically at 15 MBd, with no more than 1 mA of supply current and a threshold input current of 1.6 mA at most. The long-creepage SO6L package gives 8 mm creepage and clearance and 5000 Vrms isolation. TLP2761(TP,E is the standard-forming part on tape and reel of 1500.
key_figures: 1.3 mA max to 105 °C, 1.6 mA max to 125 °C

circuits.title: VOL test circuit
circuits.description: A current source drives the LED at IF while a second source pulls IO into the output and a voltmeter reads the low output level against ground. The supply is bypassed at the pins with 0.1 µF.

circuits.title: VOH test circuit
circuits.description: With the LED dark, a current source draws IO out of the output and a voltmeter between the supply rail and the output reads VO; the high level is VOH = VCC - VO. The grounded rail is the VCC pin side. A 0.1 µF capacitor bypasses pins 6 and 4.
notes: The rail joining pin 6 and the supply's positive side carries the ground symbol.

circuits.title: ICCL test circuit
circuits.description: A current source lights the LED at IF; an ammeter in series with the supply reads the low-level supply current. The output is left open and 0.1 µF bypasses the supply at the pins.

circuits.title: ICCH test circuit
circuits.description: The LED is left unconnected; an ammeter in series with the supply reads the high-level supply current with the output open. The supply is bypassed at the pins with 0.1 µF.

circuits.title: Switching time test circuit
circuits.description: A pulse generator drives the LED through R1 at the anode and R2 from the cathode to ground (RT = R1 + R2), giving IF = 2 mA pulses at 5 MHz, 50 % duty, with edges under 5 ns. The output is loaded only by CL, which stands for probe and stray capacitance. tpHL runs from the input's 50 % point on its rising edge to the output's 50 % point falling, tpLH runs from the input falling to the output rising; tf and tr are the output's 90 % to 10 % and 10 % to 90 % times.
notes: R1 = R2 = 840 Ω is the recommended split of RT = 1.68 kΩ.

circuits.title: Common-mode transient immunity test circuit
circuits.description: A 1000 V pulse source VCM sits between the input-side common and the output ground. Switch SW picks the LED state: at A a battery drives IF = 2 mA through R1 and R2 (output low, CML), at B the input is shorted to its common so IF = 0 (output high, CMH). The output is watched while VCM moves; the levels marked for it are 2.3 V (VCC = 3.3 V) and 4.0 V (VCC = 5.0 V) for CMH and 1.0 V for CML. A 0.1 µF capacitor bypasses pins 6 and 4.

operation.text: A GaAlAs infrared LED shines across the isolation barrier onto a high-gain, high-speed photo IC. The output is inverting: with the LED lit (input high) the output is low, and with it dark (input low) the output is high. The output stage is a totem pole of two MOSFETs, and an internal Faraday shield tied to GND holds the common-mode rejection to at least ±20 kV/µs.

The detector runs from 2.7 V to 5.5 V and draws 1.0 mA at most in either output state. A 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor between VCC (pin 6) and GND (pin 4), within 1 cm of each pin, is required for the internal amplifier to switch properly.

The LED is driven on with 2 mA to 6 mA, with input current edges faster than 0.5 µs, and held off with 0.8 V or less across it. The threshold input current is at most 1.3 mA up to 105 °C and 1.6 mA up to 125 °C. The low input current allows driving it straight from a microcontroller. The specified switching figures use RT = 1.68 kΩ split as R1 = R2 = 840 Ω at the anode and cathode.
Data rate is 15 MBd typical (NRZ). Propagation delays are 49 ns typical and 80 ns maximum in each direction, with pulse width distortion of 25 ns at most.
Factory networking, high-speed digital interfaces for instrumentation and control, and I/O interface boards.

UL1577 (file E67349), cUL to CSA CAS No. 5A (file E67349). VDE approval to EN60747-5-5, EN60065, EN60950-1 and EN 62368-1 needs the D4 option to be ordered. For safety-standard applications the standard type number TLP2761 is used, e.g. TLP2761(D4-TP,E is listed as TLP2761.
D4 is the EN60747 option, TP is tape on 12 mm pitch for the standard forming and TP4 tape for the LF4 forming, LF4 is the wide lead forming, and E marks the RoHS-compatible version.

The top carries the Toshiba mark, the part number TLP2761 (or an abbreviation code), a lot number, a process lot number, a country-of-origin letter (J for Japan, T for Thailand) and a pin-1 dot. D4 parts also carry a 4 on the lower line at the pin-1 end; their packing carries the VDE mark.

The profile is set by package surface temperature: preheat at 150 °C to 200 °C for 60 s to 120 s, at most 3 °C/s up from 217 °C, 60 s to 150 s above 217 °C, a 260 °C peak with at most 30 s within 5 °C of it, and at most 6 °C/s down. Reflow is done once or twice, and all mounting is finished within 2 weeks of the first.

Flow: preheat at 150 °C package surface temperature for 60 s to 120 s, then 260 °C for no more than 10 s, once only. Iron: no more than 10 s at a lead temperature of up to 260 °C, or 3 s at up to 350 °C, once per lead.

Store at 5 °C to 35 °C and 45 % to 75 % relative humidity, out of moisture, sunlight, corrosive gas and dust, with little temperature change, and with no load on the parts. Unpacked parts go in anti-static containers. After more than two years in storage, check the leads for solderability before use.

1500 parts per reel on embossed plastic tape. The tape starts with at least 14 empty holes and ends with at least 34 empty holes followed by more than 30 mm of cover tape alone. No two successive cavities are empty within any 40 mm, and a reel has at most six single empty cavities.
